sarvam-105b.description: Recommended - Sarvam's flagship chat model, documented as "(128K context) for complex reasoning and agentic tasks" (https://docs.sarvam.ai/api-reference-docs/chat/chat-completions, retrieved 2026-09-28). The /v1/chat/completions endpoint serves only sarvam-105b and sarvam-105b-conversations per the vendor's own reference — confirmed live by an unauthenticated GET https://api.sarvam.ai/v1/models on 2026-09-28 (HTTP 200, exactly these 2 ids, no key used). Request/response wire shape is OpenAI-compatible: messages[] with system/developer/user/assistant/tool roles, choices[].message/finish_reason (stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter, deprecated function_call), object: "chat.completion". tools + tool_choice (function calling) and response_format json_schema/json_object (Structured Outputs) are both documented generically for this endpoint, not per model — none of this was live-probed, since onboarding was credential-free (no API key, no POST request made to the vendor's API). Sarvam-specific reasoning_effort (low/high/max, default medium, disable by sending null) plus a reasoning_content field on the response message are documented — the basis for capabilities.thinking here. max_tokens defaults to 2048 if the caller omits it and the docs state no maximum output ceiling, so defaultMaxOutputTokens below reflects that documented default rather than a hard cap; maxOutputTokens is left unset on this entry rather than inventing one. Pricing is documented only in Indian Rupees — ₹29.28 input / ₹73.2 output / ₹10.98 cached-input per 1M tokens (https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/getting-started/pricing.md, retrieved 2026-09-28); pricingPerMTok is left unset here rather than placing an INR figure in a field every other catalog entry uses for USD, since the vendor states no INR/USD rate to convert by without inventing a number. The message content-part schema also declares an image_url part (standard OpenAI-compatible shape), but the vendor documents no vision/multimodal capability for either model, so vision stays false and models.visionModel is left unset.

sarvam-105b-conversations.description: Sarvam's conversational variant, documented as "(32K context) for real-time conversational and voice-agent workloads" (https://docs.sarvam.ai/api-reference-docs/chat/chat-completions, retrieved 2026-09-28) — kept as the fallback behind the larger-context sarvam-105b. Same endpoint, same OpenAI-compatible wire shape, tools/response_format documentation and reasoning_effort/reasoning_content fields as sarvam-105b (see that entry); confirmed live alongside it by the same unauthenticated GET https://api.sarvam.ai/v1/models on 2026-09-28 (HTTP 200). Pricing per the vendor's pricing page is identical to sarvam-105b — ₹29.28 input / ₹73.2 output / ₹10.98 cached-input per 1M tokens, stated only in INR — so pricingPerMTok is left unset for the same reason.

errorRules.message: Invalid Sarvam AI API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}

instructions: 1. Visit: https://dashboard.sarvam.ai and sign in or create an account
2. Create an API subscription key from the dashboard (documented format: sk_xxx)

3. Every new account receives ₹100 in starter credits, then usage-based billing applies (https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/getting-started/pricing.md) — no ongoing free tier beyond that starter credit is documented
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.sarvam.ai/v1, serving only sarvam-105b and sarvam-105b-conversations via POST /v1/chat/completions. The vendor's own API reference authenticates its raw HTTP examples with a standard Authorization: Bearer <token> header — what NeuroLink's generic OpenAI-compatible provider sends. Sarvam's stated preference is instead an api-subscription-key header, which its Python/TypeScript SDKs use; both are documented as accepted on every endpoint, so no custom auth-header quirk is needed here.
